name: loyalty_sdk
_comment_version_1_2_2: 1.2.1 -> 1.2.2: version for the coach-mark guide mounted on this SDK's primary page (GuideHost and GuideAnchor from base_sdk 1.92.0, off in demo sessions). The mount landed without a version change; see CHANGELOG.
_comment_version_1_2_0: 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0: no separate profile tile any more. The 'loyalty.customer_subscription' profile section (order 125) duplicated the profile header's existing plan row, so it is removed; the customer subscription now rides that row as a ProfileSectionRegistry action in group 'marketplace.plan' whose badgeBuilder renders CustomerSubscriptionPlanLine (plan name + state, tap opens CustomerPlansPage). CustomerSubscriptionProfileCard is replaced by CustomerSubscriptionPlanLine; CustomerPlansPage is unchanged. Needs marketplace_sdk >= 1.16.0 composed to render the line.
_comment_version_1_1_0: 1.0.2 -> 1.1.0: customer subscriptions (Uber One style). CustomerPlansPage lists plans with their benefits, subscribes paying by wallet or a saved card (the method rows are subscriptions_sdk's shared SubscriptionPaymentMethodRow), and manages the current subscription: cancel (benefits run to the end date, confirmed with the LMS cancel copy), resume, pay a past-due renewal now, change the renewal method. (1.1.0 only: a profile card 'loyalty.customer_subscription', order 125, opened it; see 1.2.0.) Talks to commerce loyalty/frappe's api.customer_subscription.* cmds; payment and auto-renewal run server-side through subscriptions_sdk's shared recurring engine. Requires subscriptions_sdk >= 1.6.0 (pubspec path ../subscriptions) and base_sdk >= 1.82.0 (the tr_keys below).

di_hooks._comment: Contributes the customer-subscription line to the profile header plan row (ProfileSectionRegistry action group marketplace.plan, rendered by marketplace_sdk >= 1.16.0). Requires base_sdk >= 1.23.0 (the profile host).
